title: CIRIS Reasoning Trace v3.1.0
description: Complete reasoning trace from the CIRIS H3ERE pipeline (FSD/TRACE_WIRE_FORMAT.md). 3.1.0 adds the LLM_CALL context_manifest member (§5.10.1). Stamped by lens-core at seal time from server 0.6 / persist v62.0; the LlmCallData and ContextManifest definitions are generated from the egress schema (tools/dev/gen_trace_format_schema.py) and compared to it by test.

trace_id.description: Trace identifier, assigned by the substrate at seal time

trace_schema_version.description: Stamped by lens-core at seal time

components.description: Ordered reasoning components (one per captured event; LLM_CALL repeats per provider call)

agent_id_hash.description: sha256(signer pubkey)[:16], denormalized from the envelope; MUST equal the trace's

k_raw.description: Nominal raw source count k before correlation adjustment

rho_mean.description: Average pairwise correlation ρ used to derive k_eff

collapse_margin.description: Positive distance from the fragility boundary; <= 0 indicates collapse-adjacent state

has_positive_moment.description: True if positive moment/gratitude was expressed
